body:
## Summary

- finalize terminal PR orchestration in the current progress note or a trusted `sepo-agent-orchestrate-stop` marker fallback
- include planner summaries and human requester mentions while retaining the existing single job and permissions
- best-effort minimize older trusted PR conversation artifacts only after validated successful outcomes
- keep final notes, pending handoffs, formal review objects, and all non-success context visible
- document the focused lifecycle and add regression coverage

This supersedes the expanded planner-job and session-persistence approach in #495.

## Verification

- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/orchestrate-handoff-cli.test.js`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/review-summary-minimize.test.js`
- `npm --prefix .agent run check:workflow`
- `npm --prefix .agent run check:docs`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #496

## Notes

- The lean scope, helper reuse, unchanged permissions, documentation, requester filtering, exact success guards, and failure handling are strong.
- Exact head `2f8a5863` passes the hosted check and independent build, 766 runtime tests, 92 workflow checks, five documentation checks, and `git diff --check`.
- Smallest useful follow-up: validate `user_message` for planner stops, make the progress path reconcile older finalized notes, and isolate optional parent-resolution failures so ordinary PR finalization still runs.

## Findings

- **WARNING — Generate context-derived artifact metadata:** A valid planner `stop` may omit `user_message`; success cleanup still proceeds, potentially minimizing the detailed review/fix context while leaving only generic outcome metadata. Require a non-empty stop summary or skip cleanup and surface an explicit fallback.
- **WARNING — Make user-facing automation idempotent:** With orchestration progress enabled, every rerun receives a fresh progress comment. Finalization merges into it before marker lookup, while cleanup preserves all marker-bearing final notes, so reruns can leave multiple visible finalized notes.
- **WARNING — Comment on accepted workflow stops:** `reportTerminalToParent()` performs strict PR-body and linked-issue reads before `commentOnTerminalPullRequestStop()`. An optional context lookup failure therefore prevents the promised terminal PR note; catch that lookup separately and fall back to ordinary finalization.

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: 2f8a5863fbfd779805fe56d88d28bfec01b1bd40 -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue

PR #497 replaces the expanded #495 implementation with the lean, single-job design requested in #496. It finalizes terminal PR orchestration in the current progress comment or a trusted marker-bearing fallback, then conditionally minimizes superseded automation artifacts after exact successful outcomes. It preserves existing permissions, formal reviews, non-success context, and release-note boundaries while adding focused tests and documentation. The intended result is one concise, durable final note without introducing planner or session architecture.

## Review

The focused architecture, authorization boundary, and overall test coverage are strong. However, current head `2f8a5863` has one core finalization failure and two state-management gaps that should be fixed before merge.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Parent-resolution failures can suppress final notes | BLOCKING | Strict parent-context reads occur before PR finalization inside the same `try`; an exception skips the final note, logs a warning, and exits successfully. |
| Successful stops do not enforce a planner summary | WARNING | An agent planner `stop` without `user_message` still qualifies for success cleanup, leaving no cumulative summary while potentially minimizing the detailed context. |
| Reruns can accumulate finalized notes | WARNING | Each run creates a fresh progress comment, while cleanup excludes every marker-bearing final note, allowing multiple finalized notes to remain visible. |

## Progress

- Current head is open and mergeable, with the hosted [Test Scripts check passing](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/actions/runs/31454144388/job/93664387799); reviewer verification also passed the build, runtime, workflow, documentation, shell, and diff checks.
- The reviewers agree that the lean scope, unchanged permissions, trust filtering, documentation, and success-only cleanup design are sound.
- Posted three non-duplicate inline comments covering [summary enforcement](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/497#discussion_r3755107968), [parent-resolution isolation](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/497#discussion_r3755107969), and [rerun reconciliation](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/497#discussion_r3755107970). No prior inline comments or threads required cleanup.
- Variable-shadowing, unused fallback scaffolding, and wording suggestions were intentionally excluded from required work because they are non-functional polish.
- Release notes remain untouched as required.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Parent-resolution failures can suppress final notes</summary>

**Cause:** [`reportTerminalToParent()`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2f8a5863fbfd779805fe56d88d28bfec01b1bd40/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1510-L1519) calls strict PR-body and linked-issue lookups before `commentOnTerminalPullRequestStop()`. Any lookup exception jumps directly to the shared catch, bypassing the core finalization path.

**Candidate solutions:** Guard parent resolution separately and fall back to attempting the ordinary PR final note when it fails. Add a regression where the PR-body or linked-issue lookup throws but the progress merge or marker fallback still publishes.

**Comments:** Codex rated this BLOCKING, the rubrics reviewer rated it WARNING, and Claude treated it as an INFO robustness edge. The synthesis treats it as BLOCKING because it directly violates #496’s terminal-note guarantee.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Successful stops do not enforce a planner summary</summary>

**Cause:** The planner schema calls `user_message` [optional](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2f8a5863fbfd779805fe56d88d28bfec01b1bd40/.github/prompts/agent-orchestrator.md#L71-L78), the parser accepts its absence, and the [success predicate](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2f8a5863fbfd779805fe56d88d28bfec01b1bd40/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1112-L1121) does not require it. Cleanup can therefore run even though the formatter has no cumulative planner summary to preserve.

**Candidate solutions:** Require a non-empty summary before treating an agent stop as cleanup-eligible, or emit an explicit safe fallback and skip cleanup. Cover a successful planner stop without `user_message`.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Reruns can accumulate finalized notes</summary>

**Cause:** The finalizer [prefers the new run’s progress comment](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2f8a5863fbfd779805fe56d88d28bfec01b1bd40/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1280-L1298), while cleanup excludes every comment containing the stop marker rather than only the current finalized comment.

**Candidate solutions:** After merging the current progress note, reconcile or minimize older trusted stop-marker notes while excluding only the current comment. Add a two-run regression asserting that exactly one finalized note remains visible.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`FIX_PR`: All three findings require concrete, localized branch changes and regression tests and are safe for an automated fix pass.

## Final Verdict

`NEEDS_REWORK`

## Action Items

- [ ] Isolate parent-resolution failures so terminal PR finalization still runs, with a lookup-failure regression.
- [ ] Enforce or safely fall back from a missing planner summary before success cleanup, with coverage.
- [ ] Reconcile older trusted finalized notes after progress-comment reuse, with a rerun regression.

---
